title: Human Heart & Internal Chambers
subject: Biology
description: Double circulation overview showing Right Atrium, Right Ventricle, Left Atrium, Left Ventricle, Bicuspid/Mitral and Tricuspid valves, Aorta, and Pulmonary Artery.

labels.name: Right Atrium
labels.function: Receives deoxygenated blood from Superior and Inferior Vena Cava (Contains SA Node at upper right corner)

labels.name: Right Ventricle
labels.function: Pumps deoxygenated blood into Pulmonary Artery through semilunar valve

labels.name: Left Atrium
labels.function: Receives oxygenated blood from 4 Pulmonary Veins

labels.name: Left Ventricle
labels.function: Thickest muscular wall; pumps oxygenated blood into systemic Aorta to supply entire body

labels.name: Systemic Aorta
labels.function: Carries oxygenated blood at peak systolic pressure (120 mm Hg) to body tissues

highYieldNcrtFacts: SA Node (Sino-atrial node) generates maximum action potentials (70-75 per min) and is the natural pacemaker.
Tricuspid valve guards the right atrio-ventricular opening; Bicuspid / Mitral valve guards the left.
First heart sound 'LUB' is produced by closure of atrio-ventricular (tricuspid and bicuspid) valves; second sound 'DUB' by closure of semilunar valves.

title: Structure of Nephron & Counter-Current System
titleHi: वृक्काणु (नेफ्रॉन) की संरचना एवं प्रतिधारा क्रियाविधि
subject: Biology
description: Functional microscopic filtration unit of the kidney: Malpighian body (Bowman's capsule + Glomerulus), PCT, Henle's Loop, DCT, and Collecting Duct.

labels.name: Glomerulus & Bowman's Capsule
labels.function: Ultrafiltration under glomerular capillary hydrostatic pressure (~60 mm Hg); Podocytes form slit pores

labels.name: Proximal Convoluted Tubule (PCT)
labels.function: Reabsorbs 70-80% of electrolytes and water, and 100% of glucose & amino acids via brush border cuboidal epithelium

labels.name: Descending Limb of Henle
labels.function: Permeable to water, impermeable to electrolytes -> tubular fluid becomes concentrated (hypertonic)

labels.name: Ascending Limb of Henle
labels.function: Impermeable to water, actively transports NaCl out into medullary interstitium -> fluid becomes hypotonic

labels.name: Distal Convoluted Tubule (DCT)
labels.function: Conditional reabsorption of Na⁺ and water under influence of Aldosterone and ADH; selective secretion of K⁺, H⁺, NH₃

highYieldNcrtFacts: Counter-current mechanism between Henle's loop and Vasa recta creates a steep osmotic gradient from 300 mOsm/L (cortex) to 1200 mOsm/L (inner medulla).
Juxtaglomerular Apparatus (JGA) consists of Macula Densa cells of DCT and specialized granular JG cells of afferent arteriole, secreting Renin when GFR falls.

title: Neuron (Nerve Cell) & Synaptic Junction
subject: Biology
description: Cyton / Cell body with Nissl's granules, Dendrites, Myelinated Axon with Nodes of Ranvier, and Synaptic Knobs containing neurotransmitter vesicles.

labels.name: Cell Body / Soma
labels.function: Contains cytoplasm, nucleus, and Nissl's granules (composed of rough ER and free ribosomes for protein synthesis)

labels.name: Dendrites
labels.function: Short, branched projections that convey electrical signals toward the cell body

labels.name: Myelinated Axon
labels.function: Schwann cells wrap around axon producing myelin sheath; enables high-speed saltatory conduction

labels.name: Nodes of Ranvier
labels.function: Gaps between adjacent myelin sheaths where voltage-gated Na⁺/K⁺ channels are concentrated

labels.name: Synaptic Knob
labels.function: Releases chemical neurotransmitters (e.g., Acetylcholine) into synaptic cleft triggered by Ca²⁺ influx

highYieldNcrtFacts: Resting potential (-70 mV): Axonal membrane is more permeable to K⁺ than to Na⁺, and impermeable to negatively charged proteins inside axoplasm.
Action potential (+30 mV): Rapid influx of Na⁺ through voltage-gated sodium channels causes depolarization.
